newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent higher, NYMEX rises, supported by API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent higher, NYMEX rises, supported by API.

text.p: April Brent crude futures in Asia were traded above overnight London levels, with players expecting a generally firm day's trading supported by API data.
April Brent on SIMEX traded just five lots at $19.53 per barrel, up eight cents from London, which rebounded overnight following the recent slump in prices.

The API reported an unexpected 3.17 million-barrel draw in gasoline stocks, when a draw of 500,000 had been expected, boosting sentiment that stocks might be too low heading into the U.S. driving season.
A strike threat in Nigeria was adding to support for the market. Workers of Nigeria's Department if Petroleum Resources have threatened strike action from Friday over back pay.
NYMEX April crude, which rose 29 cents in New York, was last traded on ACCESS at $21.16, up 16 cents from New York,
NYMEX March gasoline built on its 1.99-cent gain in New York to add 0.47 cent on ACCESS. It was last traded at 62.70.
